summary: This standards-track document defines two techniques to improve the scalability of RSVP-TE deployments: Refresh-Interval Independent RSVP and Per-Peer Flow Control. They reduce the processing cycles and handling needed as the number of LSPs grows. The aim is to help networks whose equipment struggles with many LSPs.

eli5.summary: A teacher who keeps checking on every student gets tired. This tells the students to check in less often so the teacher can handle a bigger class.
